item.title: Drought, fire and high diesel prices 'addin' up tough' for Oregon ranchers
item.description: Source: npr.org. Record diesel prices are kicking Western ranchers while they're down. Drought means they have to buy extra hay, and pay truckers extra to deliver it because of fuel price hikes.
